def safe_cv(
    std,
    mean,
):
    std = np.asarray(
        std,
        dtype=float,
    )

    mean = np.asarray(
        mean,
        dtype=float,
    )

    out = np.zeros_like(
        mean,
        dtype=float,
    )

    mask = (
        np.isfinite(std)
        & np.isfinite(mean)
        & (np.abs(mean) > 1e-12)
    )

    out[mask] = (
        std[mask]
        / np.abs(mean[mask])
    )

    return out

def slope_pct_per_year(
    g: pd.DataFrame,
):
    x = g["year"].to_numpy(
        dtype=float
    )

    y = g["traffic_mean"].to_numpy(
        dtype=float
    )

    mask = (
        np.isfinite(x)
        & np.isfinite(y)
    )

    x = x[mask]
    y = y[mask]

    if len(x) < 2:
        return np.nan

    mean_y = np.mean(y)

    if abs(mean_y) < 1e-12:
        return 0.0

    slope = np.polyfit(
        x,
        y,
        1,
    )[0]

    return float(
        slope / mean_y
    )

    .groupby(
